# Third-party code in this folder

These files are copied unchanged (apart from a licence header) from their projects.

| File | Project | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `preact-htm.js` | [Preact](https://github.com/preactjs/preact) with hooks, and [htm](https://github.com/developit/htm), as htm's standalone bundle | Preact: MIT, © Jason Miller. htm: Apache-2.0, © Jason Miller |
| `marked.min.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) v12.0.2 | MIT, © Christopher Jeffrey and others |
| `purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) v3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0, © Cure53 and other contributors |

The Code tab's editor, [Monaco](https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor) v0.57.0 (MIT, © Microsoft), is not in this folder: the server downloads it from npm on first use (lib/monaco.ts).

The full licence texts are in each project's repository.
